appearance_facts.fact: A pale-yellow wedge occupies the largest visible angular extent of the pie, spanning roughly from the 12 o'clock position to the 9 o'clock position.
An orange wedge is the second-largest visible area, extending from the 12 o'clock position to approximately the 4 o'clock position.
A dark-red wedge occupies the lower-left quadrant, appearing smaller than the pale-yellow wedge.
A light-orange wedge is the smallest visible segment, located at the bottom of the chart.
All four wedges converge at a central point, forming a complete circle.
The text 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' is printed in the top-left corner.

public_definitions: Identify the largest global energy consumption source category
Route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle
Routing criterion: Largest global energy consumption category
